summary: Bundle D (Center lifecycle) frontend E2E tested end-to-end for center Stealth Family (cf5a475c04cd4860976920cda63fa6ff). All owner, member, and admin lifecycle flows PASS. No blockers. Fire Power wording preserved; no monetary language surfaced anywhere. Final state restored to ACTIVE, no pending transfer, no pending closure, no retention hold, tftwo remains an active member.
critical_code_review_comments: RcLifecyclePanel.jsx line 73 renders 'Vault: {lc.vault_balance} Fire Power' — safe. All destructive actions correctly gated by typed center-name confirmation and (for closure) an additional exact phrase + reason>=5 chars. Submit buttons remain disabled until predicates pass — verified via UI.

RcLifecycleAdminTab.jsx uses window.prompt for the mandatory reason on retention-hold toggle, restore, closure decisions — works but window.prompt is a jarring UX; consider replacing with an inline modal for consistency with the rest of the app.

Transfer 'to' dropdown renders raw <option> containing @username + role — hydration warning in console ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>') because the Radix Select style dropdown implementation is being wrapped inside a native <select>. Non-blocking, but should be cleaned up.

Closure state (closure.status = 'canceled') persists on the admin Lifecycle state grid even after cancel — this is expected historical data but the display 'Closure: canceled' with a still-shown 'Cancel window ends' line could confuse admins (looks pending). Consider hiding cancellation deadline when status is canceled/completed/denied.
